title: aeluropus littoralis var. mesopotamicus
intro: Aeluropus littoralis var. mesopotamicus, commonly known as Mesopotamian sand-grass or Desert grass, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aeluropus littoralis var. mesopotamicus include its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic properties, making the plant a potential candidate for the development of new medicines.
